chronology: The manuscript v1.7.4 and its outcomes had already been inspected when these studies were chosen. This is an author revision study, not external preregistration and not a replacement of N or original DV.
failure_policy: Retain all outcomes. Stop on integrity or numerical failure, preserve evidence, never substitute favorable seeds. Resource interruptions resume the same predefined task.
purpose: Assess horizon and penalty dependence of the existing path-order x threshold-origin factorial. Do not treat division by horizon as independent evidence of robustness.

fixed.axis: original moment-pool Signed-selected axis in each split
fixed.recursion: two-sided CUSUM; k=0.05; strict >; no onset/first-alarm reset or latching
fixed.limits: original saved D2 limits; do not recalibrate shortened horizons
fixed.path_permutations: original D2 deterministic stream exactly, not original S31 stream

endpoints.horizon_loss: first post-fault delay if no pre-alarm and detection by H; otherwise H, all 75 fault runs retained
endpoints.clean_success: no pre-alarm AND post-fault crossing by H, denominator75
endpoints.penalty_loss: first delay if clean within original full horizon; otherwise selected penalty P
endpoints.decomposition: mean penalized loss = sum(clean delay)/n + P*failure_rate; interaction follows the same exact linear identity
endpoints.normalized_loss: L/H only for display/comparison of relative magnitude; not a distinct inferential check
endpoints.normal_far: existing 960-point full-normal-episode rate, unchanged across horizon/penalty scoring

aggregation: Average20 permutations within each split, compute all four cells and six factorial contrasts within each split, then report across-ten-split mean, median, min, max and negative/zero/positive counts. No independent-split CI or p-value. Never subtract displayed medians for additive accounting.
original_parity_checks: all stored event records vs original PER_REPETITION.csv
all original interaction summaries vs INTERACTION_PER_SPLIT/SUMMARY
complete expected keys:10 splits x3 blocks x20 repetitions x3 families x2 path factors x2 limit factors =7200 rows, each75 events
where exact S30 numeric inputs available, recurrence replay and equality to original records before revised endpoints
scope: Existing-record post-outcome sensitivity; no new trajectories, direction fitting, optimization, population guarantee or physical causal attribution.
